---
name: Team sync
about: The one pinned issue where coders talk to each other (BLOCKER, INTERFACE, READY).
title: "Team sync"
labels: sync
---

This issue is how the coders talk to each other. Read all comments before each step.

Post a comment when you are blocked, when you change a shared interface, or when you finish something others depend on.

Format:

```text
<BLOCKER|INTERFACE|READY>: task <number> -> task <number or "all">
<what you need or what changed, in two or three lines>
```

Do not put secrets in comments.
